title: Milos evidence exports are now self-contained
details: The Evidence Viewer now follows the Evia self-contained viewer pattern in Milos blue
The observation PDF and evidence media are embedded inside the viewer while the original files remain separately in the ZIP
Assessment criteria remain grouped and searchable, with recorded timestamps opening the correct evidence point
Learner, assessor, witness, mapping and observation context are preserved in the exported viewer
Learners, reviews, observations, QR exchange and evidence capture behaviour are otherwise unchanged
